objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.meaning.update.query
objective.description: Refresh the local root meaning projection incrementally, query it through a projected filter, and branch on the resulting selected element.

#root.role: Ask the local root to incrementally refresh one projected capacity descriptor, query the refreshed projection with a projected objective.description filter, and branch on the selected element name.

effects.root_meaning_update: The local root projection is incrementally refreshed for one element.
effects.root_meaning_query: The local root projection is queried after refresh.
effects.branch_terminal_route: The terminal route depends on the refreshed local reflective value.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes a branch-specific terminal response after refreshing the local root projection and selecting the matching element through a projected query filter.
invariants: The local root projection is incrementally refreshed for sandbox.echo before meaning.query applies its projected objective.description filter.
The branch decision is taken from the first projected query row name returned after update.
success: The terminal payload exposes echo and ctx_id from the selected local sandbox.echo branch.
When the updated projection exposes sandbox.echo under the patched description, the flow terminates through message meaning-updated.
failure: The flow fails if meaning.update or meaning.query cannot complete after their retry policy is exhausted.
The flow can terminate through the stale else branch if the refreshed projection does not expose the expected selected row.
notes: Despite its name, this scenario exercises local root-level reflexive update/query after the descriptor is patched by the test harness.
N7 validates both the terminal branch payload and an explicit follow-up meaning.query on the refreshed projection.
